current_issues.description: Dev web MMKV key mismatch + wrong build URL: app uses localStorage key 'server-config\custom-server-url' but all injection scripts and CLAUDE.md document 'mmkv.server-config\custom-server-url' (wrong prefix). Additionally dev web built with HAPPY_SERVER_URL=https://api-dev.life-ai.app but token is only valid for api.life-ai.app. Both issues compound to make dev.life-ai.app completely non-functional (47+ 401 errors in polling loop).

Bug #63: Horizontal scroll indicator hardcoded false for code blocks (all platforms) and false on web for tables. Users cannot discover that wide content is scrollable. Content visually clips at container edge with no affordance.

Bug #64A+B: TaskView title duplicated in detail page (title appears in nav bar AND Description section body text) AND missing divider between header and tool items list. Bug #64C (clickability) is CONFIRMED FIXED.

Agent metadata leaks into TaskView Output section -- agentId, SendMessage instructions, and <usage> XML tags visible to end users. Output section also not Markdown-rendered (bold/code syntax shows as raw text).
LaTeX formula not rendered -- $$E = mc^2$$ displays as raw text with dollar-sign delimiters visible. No math rendering engine (KaTeX/MathJax) is active for inline content.

Bug #62: change_title MCP tool updates wrong field -- sends type='summary' which updates metadata.summary.text (compact description) not the display title. Additionally knownTools.tsx registers renderer under 'change_title' but Claude calls it as 'mcp__happy__change_title' (auto-prefixed), causing rendering key mismatch.

Bug #61: Mermaid timeline with Chinese characters silently drops events instead of rendering them. Events with ellipsis markers (...trading..., ...continue...) and Chinese labels are absent from SVG output. No sanitizeMermaid function present.

6 Claude tool types missing from knownTools.tsx: EnterWorktree, ExitWorktree, CronCreate, CronDelete, CronList, Skill. These fall back to generic rendering with construct-outline icon and raw tool name.

Image/file download completely missing -- users can upload and view images in chat but cannot save, download, or share them. Binary files in file viewer show dead-end 'Cannot display binary' with no action.
CLAUDE.md documentation has wrong MMKV injection key -- will mislead all future agents and Playwright scripts.
